# incident_announcement_template (Resource)

Create and manage announcement templates.

An announcement template controls which fields and actions appear on an announcement post.
Each announcement rule renders its posts with one template.


`fields` and `actions` appear on the post in the order they're listed.

Which template is the organisation's default is set in the dashboard, and the default template can't be deleted: import it to manage its fields, but remove it from state rather than destroying it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A template for major incidents: severity and status first, then a note asking people
# to join. Fields and actions appear on the post in the order they're listed.
resource "incident_announcement_template" "major_incidents" {
  name = "Major incidents"

  fields = [
    {
      field_type = "announcement_post_fields_severity"
      emoji      = "fire"
    },
    {
      field_type = "announcement_post_fields_status"
    },
    {
      field_type = "announcement_post_fields_rich_text"
      rich_text = {
        type = "markdown"
        # Incident variables are written as {{name}}.
        contents = "If you can help, please join {{incident.reference}}"
      }
    },
  ]

  actions = [
    { action_type = "announcement_post_actions_join_call" },
    { action_type = "announcement_post_actions_homepage" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes List) Actions shown on the announcement post, in rank order. Set `actions = []` for a post with no actions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `fields` (Attributes List) Fields shown on the announcement post, in rank order. Set `fields = []` for a post with no fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `name` (String) Name of this announcement template, unique within the organisation

### Optional

- `owning_team_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the teams that own this template

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this announcement template
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organisation's default template, used by rules that don't choose one

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `action_type` (String) Type of this action. Possible values are: `announcement_post_actions_homepage`, `announcement_post_actions_subscribe`, `announcement_post_actions_join_call`, `announcement_post_actions_jira_ticket`, `announcement_post_actions_internal_status_page`, `announcement_post_actions_public_status_page`, `announcement_post_actions_postmortem`, `announcement_post_actions_create_channel`, `announcement_post_actions_view_alert`, `announcement_post_actions_triage`, `announcement_post_actions_escalate`, `announcement_post_actions_share_update`, `announcement_post_actions_update_status`, `announcement_post_actions_request_access`.

Optional:

- `emoji` (String) Emoji shown on this action's button, as a Slack emoji name


<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Required:

- `field_type` (String) Type of this field. Possible values are: `announcement_post_fields_status`, `announcement_post_fields_incident_type`, `announcement_post_fields_severity`, `announcement_post_fields_role`, `announcement_post_fields_description`, `announcement_post_fields_custom_field`, `announcement_post_fields_timestamp`, `announcement_post_fields_creator`, `announcement_post_fields_slack`, `announcement_post_fields_rich_text`.

Optional:

- `custom_field_id` (String) ID of the custom field to show. Required for custom field fields.
- `emoji` (String) Emoji shown next to this field, as a Slack emoji name
- `incident_role_id` (String) ID of the incident role to show. Required for incident role fields.
- `incident_timestamp_id` (String) ID of the incident timestamp to show. Required for incident timestamp fields.
- `rich_text` (Attributes) Content of a rich text field. The type says how contents is written. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--rich_text))

<a id="nestedatt--fields--rich_text"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields.rich_text`

Required:

- `contents` (String) The content, as markdown. Write incident variables as {{name}}, e.g. {{incident.reference}}.
- `type` (String) How contents is written. Only markdown is supported today. Possible values are: `markdown`.

## Import

Import is supported using an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) or the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import):

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash

# Import an announcement template using its ID
# Replace the ID with a real ID from your incident.io organization
terraform import incident_announcement_template.example 01ABC123DEF456GHI789JKL
```
